scheme_name: Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses (Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, Veterinary, and Law)
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a student.
The beneficiary must be pursuing a professional course in a Government, government‑aided or self‑financing college.
There must be no graduate in the beneficiary’s family.
benefits_summary: Full payment of tuition, special and other non‑refundable compulsory fees, as well as full reimbursement of examination fees.
